idea.copy: Thu 5 Nov, the day after Wednesday's 'AI now acts first' piece. Your idea (28 Oct): a clean, well-lit to-camera 1-2-3 with fast subtitle builds and a strong thumbnail. About 40 seconds. Your AI is a puppy. One: it wants to please you. Two: so it tells you what you want to hear. Three: so ask it for the best case against your idea. Made to the visual quality and feeling of the short you saved on 31 Oct.

briefs.his_direction: Good, but let's do a piece on the proactive agents and literally give instructions as I gave my friend on how to have our AI tool set its own spending and sending limits, given proactive personal assistants are coming

briefs.format: Meme carousel, made fresh in the brand kit

idea.copy: Tue 3 Nov, the day after Monday's piece. Four cards, 4:5. Card 1: CLAUDE IS EATING THE JOBS OF ITS OWN HUMANS (huge yellow type, a cartoon robot holding a tiny office ladder). Card 2: The rungs juniors used to learn on are the ones AI does first (the ladder with its bottom rungs missing). Card 3: So who trains the seniors of 2030? (an empty chair at the top). Card 4: The full story is on Monday's video (Monday's cover).

briefs.his_direction: Go for it, visual quality but not dip beneath the video production quality

briefs.format: Meme video, made fresh in the brand kit

idea.copy: Tue 3 Nov. Your idea (28 Oct): the translator scene you saved, reskinned for when your AI talks to your customer's AI. Two identical robots across a table, each insisting the other is the translator, forty minutes to agree a refund nobody asked for, one human in the corner checking his watch. Subtitles at the fast pace you saved. Format credited to the original clip; none of its footage is used.
